subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The life of the church seems, indeed, to have been in a more stagnant and ______ condition in this age than at any other period of English history.
solution:
Here, the correct answer is "torpid."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "torpid" would fit in the blank.
 
• **"Torpid"** refers to a state of inactivity, sluggishness, or lethargy. (निष्क्रियता, सुस्ती या सुस्ती की स्थिति)
 
 
• **Example**:* The **torpid**__ cat lazily stretched out in the sun, showing no interest in the activities around it.*
 
 
 
• It describes something that is dormant, slow-moving, or lacking in energy and vitality.
 
• In a broader sense, it can be used to characterize a lack of responsiveness or a dull, unenergetic condition.
 
• Here,** "torpid" **suggests a state of inactivity, sluggishness, or stagnation in describing the condition of the church.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

Correct sentence*: The life of the church seems, indeed, to have been in a more stagnant and __**torpid**__ condition in this age than at any other period of English history.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Tangential: **something that is only slightly or indirectly related to a particular topic, concept, or discussion. (कुछ ऐसा जो किसी विशेष विषय, अवधारणा या चर्चा से थोड़ा या अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से संबंधित हो)
 
• **Truculent: **eager or quick to argue or fight; aggressively defiant. (बहस करने या लड़ने के लिए उत्सुक या तत्पर; आक्रामक रूप से उद्दंड)
 
• **Expedite: **to make something happen more quickly. (प्रक्रिया को तेज़ करना; शीघ्रता करना)
